feeds.title: Nearly Legal Blog
feeds.description: Updates on housing and landlord & tenant law. Issues covered include homelessness, possession & forfeiture, unlawful eviction, disrepair & housing fitness, regulation & licensing, right to manage, and anything else that interests us. Contents include frequent case reports, updates on statute law, guides, and key documents.

feeds.title: NHLP
feeds.description: NHLP achieves housing justice by enforcing the rights of tenants, increasing housing opportunities for underserved communities, and preserving safe housing. The National Housing Law Project (NHLP) is a housing law & advocacy center, established in 1968.

feeds.title: The Landlord Law Blog
feeds.description: An online information service site that has interesting articles, news, and tips on residential landlord & tenant law and practice. It helps landlords and tenants understand their legal rights and obligations.

feeds.title: Alexander Holburn » Housing
feeds.description: Focuses on housing law news & updates in Canada. Alexander Holburn is a Vancouver-based Canadian law firm providing a wide range of litigation, dispute resolution, and business law services to clients throughout Canada & abroad.

feeds.title: Alliance For Housing Justice Blog
feeds.description: Learn about housing justice & the issues that impact housing today. Find articles on Affordable Housing, Fair Housing, Housing Justice, and other press releases. Alliance for Housing Justice believes that a safe, quality, affordable place to live is a fundamental human right.

feeds.title: The Fair Housing Center Blog
feeds.description: Get the latest news, legal updates, rights, and press releases. The Fair Housing Center's mission is to protect and expand fair housing rights, eliminate housing discrimination, and promote integrated communities.

feeds.title: The KSN Blog » Landlord & Tenant Law
feeds.description: Find the latest legal updates on Landlord & Tenant Law. Since 1983, KSN has been a legal resource for condominium, homeowner, and townhome associations.

feeds.title: Public Advocates » Housing
feeds.description: This section of the Public Advocates blog features articles that have to do exclusively with the Housing Sector. Public Advocates, a civil rights law firm building community power & achieving legal victories that advance education, housing, transportation equity, and climate justice.

feeds.title: Housing Solutions Blog
feeds.description: Housing Solutions is the lead agency for the Tulsa County HUD-funded Continuum of Care (CoC). Our blog posts cover Advocacy, Legal Resources, Eviction, Homelessness, Landlord, and Legal Agency Updates.

feeds.title: Housing Justice
feeds.description: Stay up on the latest news, updates, and events by Housing Justice. Housing Justice is a small, highly influential national charity with a vision is of a society where everyone has access to a home that truly meets their needs.

feeds.title: The NAHRO Blog
feeds.description: Updates & Analysis on federal housing & community development regulations & legislation. Key topics covered are Community Development, Federal Funding & Regulation, Eviction, and Public Housing. NAHRO is a leading membership association for professionals in the housing & community development industry.

feeds.title: Central Alabama Fair Housing Center Blog
feeds.description: Keep up with the latest insights from CAFHC Blog. CAFHC is a non-profit civil rights agency dedicated to eliminating housing discrimination, enforcing fair housing laws, and educating individuals regarding fair housing laws.

feeds.title: Housing After Grenfell Blog
feeds.description: Covers a range of Housing Law topics, with a focus on Bankruptcy, Building Regulations, Cladding, Enforcement, Human Rights, Social Housing, Interim Measures, and Retrofit. The Faculty of Law at the University of Oxford is one of the largest in the United Kingdom.

feeds.title: Himmelstein McConnell Gribben & Joseph LLP Blog
feeds.description: New York City Landlord-Tenant Law Blog. We cover a range of topics including Eviction Prevention, Landlord-tenant Law, Tenants' Rights, Rent Stabilization, and Firm News. HMGDJ is a New York based law firm with a singular dedication to protecting tenants.
